name: quioteframework/queue
description: Background job/queue abstraction (job interface, sync driver, retry/dead-letter handling, queue:work console command) for Quiote.

suggest.quioteframework/queue-db: Adds a DB-backed queue driver (Quiote\Queue\Db\DbQueueDriver) for out-of-process workers.

extra.quiote-monorepo-note: Developed in-tree under quioteframework/quiote's packages/queue/; split to this standalone repo via splitsh/lite on tag push. PRs go to the monorepo, not here.
